## Install

```bash
brew install erhangundogan/tap/primum
```

or

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/erhangundogan/primum/main/install.sh | sh
```

Or download an archive below and put `primum` on your `PATH`.

| platform | archive |
|---|---|
| Apple Silicon Mac | `aarch64-apple-darwin` |
| Intel Mac | `x86_64-apple-darwin` |
| Linux x86_64 | `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu` |
| Linux ARM64 | `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu` |

Each has a `.sha256` alongside it. Every archive is downloaded onto a clean machine and run before this release is published.

`primum serve` opens the board in your browser.
